topLists.quickAnswerDescription: The strongest current options, with prices in RON and a clear reason for each choice.
topLists.methodology: We order wines by Value Score, current price in RON, medals and awards when available, vintage and store availability. We limit the number of wines from one winery in the top five to keep the selection diverse.
limitations: Prices can vary by retailer and promotion.
The VinIntel editorial team has not tasted every wine.
Value Score is not the same as a user review rating.
topLists.avoidHeading: What to avoid in a very cheap wine
avoidItems: Labels without a clear winery, region or vintage.
An unusually low price without a Value Score or market data.
Promotions without real stock at verified stores.

dish.faqPriceAnswer: Yes. We show prices in RON as either a recently verified price or an estimate, depending on the source.

sarmale.name: Sarmale
sarmale.heading: What wine goes with sarmale?
sarmale.metaTitle: Wine for sarmale: Romanian picks under 50 RON
sarmale.metaDescription: The best Romanian wines for sarmale, with dry red styles, Value Scores, prices in RON and clear pairing guidance.
sarmale.intro: Sarmale call for a dry red wine with lively acidity and gentle tannins. These Romanian wines can balance the rich filling, cabbage and spices.

gratar.name: Romanian barbecue
gratar.heading: What wine goes with Romanian barbecue?
gratar.metaTitle: Wine for Romanian barbecue: top local pairings
gratar.metaDescription: Romanian red and rosé wines for grilled meat, with prices in RON and transparent Value Scores.
gratar.intro: Romanian barbecue works well with medium to full-bodied wines, ripe tannins and generous red fruit. These choices suit grilled meat without overpowering it.

peste.name: Fish
peste.heading: What wine goes with fish?
peste.metaTitle: Wine for fish: dry Romanian whites and rosés
peste.metaDescription: Dry Romanian white and rosé wines for fish, selected for freshness, acidity and prices in RON.
peste.intro: Fish usually suits dry white or rosé wines with bright acidity and restrained fruit. This selection avoids heavy styles that can overwhelm the dish.

friptura-de-porc.name: Roast pork
friptura-de-porc.heading: What wine goes with roast pork?
friptura-de-porc.metaTitle: Wine for roast pork: dry Romanian red wines
friptura-de-porc.metaDescription: Dry Romanian red wines for roast pork, ranked by Value Score with current prices in RON.
friptura-de-porc.intro: Roast pork works with a balanced dry red that offers soft tannins and ripe fruit. The ranking avoids wines that are too heavy or too sweet.

cozonac.name: Cozonac
cozonac.heading: What wine goes with cozonac?
cozonac.metaTitle: Wine for cozonac: sweet and sparkling Romanian picks
cozonac.metaDescription: Romanian sweet, medium-sweet and sparkling wines for cozonac, with current prices in RON.
cozonac.intro: Cozonac pairs well with sweet or medium-sweet wines showing dried fruit, honey or vanilla notes. These Romanian choices complement the traditional sweet bread.
